program.name: SL Strength — Hardwood Force Block
program.goal: Build strength, power, speed, and durability for basketball athletes.
program.targetAthlete: Division I basketball player — offseason development
program.description: A 4-week accumulation mesocycle for offseason DI basketball. Upper/lower movement split, 4 days/week. Power precedes strength precedes accessory/durability. Main lifts wave 75%→80%→82.5% (W1–W3) then deload to 65% (W4); power stays low-rep/high-quality; accessories are RPE-driven. Percentages are of estimated 1RM. Maps 1:1 onto the Notion Programs + Workouts databases.
